lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows on the lateral flank, forming a regular geometric grid posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes where pixel intensity is maximized.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to low-luminance shadows immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 8-10 small, high-luminance blobs concentrated within the lower half of the first dorsal fin macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, high-luminance spots is visible along the posterior margin of the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
